title: Product Slider

| It must be possible for the user to select how extensive the displayed product tiles should be. It must be possible to adjust the background color of the product images (if transparent pngs are used) for the products in the slider. summary: A horizontally scrollable product carousel for browsing and discovering products with configurable tile displays and navigation.
features: Configurable navigation position with optional headline, subline, and CTA button
Customizable product tile detail level from minimalist to comprehensive with optional Add to Cart
Light and dark color modes with adjustable image background for transparent PNGs
Product sourcing via manual SKU entry, category IDs, labels, or automated recommendations
longDescription:
## Purpose

The Product Slider component provides store visitors with an engaging, horizontally scrollable carousel for browsing products across the catalog. It enables quick discovery and comparison of multiple items without navigating away from the current page.

## Use Cases

- **Homepage product discovery**: Showcase featured, new arrival, or bestseller products
- **Category cross-selling**: Display related products from complementary categories
- **Promotional campaigns**: Highlight sale items or products with specific labels
- **Personalized recommendations**: Present algorithmically suggested products

## Design Rationale

The component supports both minimalist and information-rich product tile configurations, allowing merchants to balance visual appeal with purchase decision data. Dual color modes ensure seamless integration into varied page designs, while flexible product sourcing options support both manual curation and automated population.
shortDescription: Scrollbar visibility can be toggled for navigation feedback preference. Selectable image aspect ratio (1:1 or 3:4) overrides global settings per slider instance. Supports multiple product sourcing methods enabling both manual curation and automated population based on categories or labels.
